name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-16 CRITICAL 1054 FIX: v2_upsert_company INSERT failed SQLSTATE[42S22] Unknown column 'owner_user_id' — the pre-existing companies table predates owner_user_id (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op on existing tables and no ALTER ever added it), so every upsert aborted. Fixes (public/cpanel/api.php): (1) tcEnsureNormalizedTables now ALTERs companies ADD COLUMN owner_user_id VARCHAR(64) BEFORE the other company fields (idempotent try/catch — MySQL 8.0 has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS); (2) new tcTableColumns() introspects the LIVE schema via INFORMATION_SCHEMA (cached per request) and tcUpsertCompanyRow now builds INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dynamically, whitelisting every column against the actual table: owner_user_id/theme_color/logo/etc. are silently skipped if absent instead of throwing 1054; (3) created_at is never overwritten, deleted_at stays NULL on duplicate (soft-delete guard preserved), values are bound positionally. Acceptance: deploy head commit -> hard refresh -> add company -> console [Direct MySQL] v2_upsert_company RESPONSE {success:true} -> SELECT * FROM companies WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC shows the row; on legacy DBs owner_user_id is auto-added on first request. Table is 'companies' (NOT tradecore_companies).
